Maria: Morning handoff — quick overnight summary and current state.
Maria: Primary = Maria (09:00-17:00 PT). Secondary = AJ (escalation window next 6h). No active pages at handoff. Coverage note: APAC overnight shift tomorrow currently unfilled (see Dena's note below).
Maria: Incidents handled overnight:
Maria: 1) 02:12 UTC — Tokenization service (tokenizer-v2.4) started returning 500s for ~7 minutes. Error rate peaked ~15% for text.generate requests. Mitigation: rolled back to tokenizer-v2.3 at 02:20 UTC which restored baseline. Incident flagged as partial customer impact (text.generate only), no data loss, no persisted prompt leakage.
Maria: 2) 05:40 UTC — Embeddings latency spike on embed-queue due to controller throttling preventing HPA from scaling. Manual scale applied at 05:45 UTC; latency recovered by 05:52 UTC. Root cause suspected: burst of controller api-server calls + K8s leader election jitter.
Maria: Current status: All systems green in Console, no ongoing mitigation tasks, postmortem scheduled tomorrow 14:00 PT. Immediate postmortem owners: Maria (tokenizer rollback) & AJ (embeddings scaling)
Maria: Customer impact summary: small percentage of requests got 5xx during 02:12-02:20 UTC window; engineering page was paged and handled. Billing unaffected.
Maria: Runbook pointers:
Maria: - Tokenizer rollback: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tokenizer-fallback (steps 1-5, include canary verification)
Maria: - HPA/Controller throttle checklist: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/k8s-autoscaler-throttle
Maria: Quick health checks you can run if paged:
Maria: ```
Maria: # check tokenizer health
Maria: curl -sS https://tokenizer.internal.redwood/health || echo "down"
Maria: # tail recent error logs
Maria: kubectl -n inference logs deploy/tokenizer --since=10m | tail -n 200
Maria: ```
Maria: Next steps for today:
Maria: - AJ to publish alert tuning proposal by EOD for controller throttling (assign: AJ)
Maria: - Owner for canary rollout of tokenizer-v2.3->v2.4 compatibility test: Maria/Runtime team, schedule 14:00 PT canary
Maria: - Add synthetic test for tokenizer edgecases to CI (low priority but requested by SRE)
Maria: Handing off the on-call to AJ for the next 6 hours. @AJ please ack and take escalations.
AJ: Acked. I'll monitor the tokenizer and embeddings dashboards for the next 6h and will update if anything trips. I'll also draft the alert tuning doc in the next 3 hours.
sre-bot: Incident 2026-03-14-142 tokenization-500s created at 1741999960, status: resolved, severity: P2. Actions logged: rollback-to-tokenizer-v2.3, added temporary 4m rate limit to tokenizer ingress.
sre-bot: Incident 2026-03-14-143 embeddings-latency created at 1742002800, status: resolved, severity: P3. Actions logged: manual-scale replicas=+4.
Kai: Thanks for the summary — one question: do we have any lingering KV cache which might be inconsistent after the rollback? I saw a few token mis-matches in QA.
Maria: Good call. We validated KV cache TTLs; no invalidation required because change was tokenizer code-path only. I ran a spot check: `redis-cli -h kv-cache.svc TTL tokenizer:cache` showed normal TTLs.
AJ: I'll keep an eye on consumer error logs for 24h. If we see persistent mis-tokenization errors, we'll trigger a more thorough cache verification.
Dena: Heads-up: APAC overnight coverage for Thu-Fri morning is currently unassigned. We should either rotate someone (small swap) or bump the overlap by 2 hours tomorrow. @oncall-rotation can we please check volunteers?
oncall-rotation: Noted. I'll post the rotation swap poll in #eng-oncall after this thread. If no volunteers within 2h, we'll default to +2h overlap tomorrow.
Kai: Quick operational note — if anyone needs to reproduce the tokenizer error locally, use the stress script under infra/tools/tokenizer-stress. It reproduces edge-case input truncation seen in prod.
Maria: Final notes: no customer-facing comms required at this time; support informed for any escalations. Postmortem owners will draft a short summary for the 14:00 PT meeting.
AJ: Acknowledged. I'll post a short status update here at 12:00 PT and ping @Maria for the postmortem prep.
Maria: Thanks team — leaving the channel in good state. :thumbsup:
AJ: :thumbsup:
Dena: Thanks, will watch for the rotation poll.
sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem meeting 14:00 PT in #eng-runtime. Calendar invite sent to Maria, AJ, Kai, Dena.
